component.name: World-wide High-speed Rail Tycoon
component.summary: Build and run high-speed rail lines across real geography

description.p: A strategic railway business game about operating and expanding the world's high-speed rail networks. Plan monthly business turns, watch an animated operating day, and compete for passengers through fares, frequency, speed and useful connections.

Real geography shapes expansion: compare longer valley routes with expensive mountain works, tunnels and bridges, balancing construction time and upkeep against journey speed. Single-player runs offline.
